assist-tick-hint: A click on every note at the moment it should be hit, played whether you hit it or not — so a missed note still tells you where it was.
backdrop-hint: A visualiser behind the playfield, drawn from the track's own analysed waveform — so it moves with the music, not on a timer of its own. It also opens up as your combo climbs and drains as the health gauge falls. Always under the notes, never over them. Reduced Flash, reduced motion and Effect Intensity all override this.
combo-position-hint: Where the combo sits, or whether it appears at all. Centre is over the playfield, which is where it is most readable and most in the way.
effect-intensity-hint: Scales screen shake, playfield rotation and particles together. At 0 the playfield holds still and only the notes move.
extra-binds-conflict: Bound to both lanes, so Lane B never sees it: {{binds}}
extra-binds-hint: A lane can answer to more than one key. Alternating two keys on one lane is how a fast jack is played.
health-gauge-hint: Misses drain a gauge. Solo, emptying it ends the run; in a match it only costs the bonus. Worth a score multiplier.
input-offset-hint: Shifts when your press is judged, without moving the music. Positive if you consistently read EARLY — the audio offset is for the other half, and calibration sets that one.
judgement-floor-hint: The worst judgement that still gets a popup. Set it to GREAT and MARVELOUS/PERFECT stop firing — on a good run those two are constant, carry no information, and sit on top of the notes behind them.
lane-palette-hint: Colour-vision-safe lane pairs. Each one is separated in brightness as well as hue, because two mid-tone blobs moving at speed are hard to tell apart however different their colour is. Overrides the skin.
line-position-hint: How far in from the edge the hit line sits. Further in gives you more runway to read the approach and less room after it.
metronome-hint: A click on every beat, whether or not there is a note there. The fastest way to hear that you are rushing a section rather than misreading it.
modifier-presets-hint: Save the modifiers you have selected right now under a name, and get back to them in one tap instead of re-toggling nine switches.
preset-empty: No presets yet. Set your modifiers on a track, then come back and name the setup — it will be one tap to get back to it.
quant-colors-hint: Colour notes by where they land in the beat — red on the beat, blue on eighths, purple on triplets, yellow on sixteenths.
reduced-flash-hint: Caps how much the screen may brighten between frames and drops the decorative flashes entirely. Separate from the performance tier — a fast machine still gets the full effect unless you turn this on.
